title: March for justice for Zamy Wanderson outside the Education Ministry
location: Outside the Ministry of National Education, Delmas 83, Port-au-Prince
scope: A separate march by hundreds, mostly young people, demanding justice for a passerby killed during the Aug 18 Education Ministry sit-in incident.
organizer: Organizer not named in the CIVICUS compilation; participants described as mostly young people.

state_target.target: Ministry of National Education/State accountability for its security staff member’s fatal shooting.
state_target.evidence: The demonstration demanded justice after a Ministry security guard shot and killed a passerby during an earlier teachers’ sit-in.

demands_original: Demand justice for Zamy Wanderson, who was fatally shot by a Ministry security agent while passing the earlier sit-in.
participants_original: CIVICUS reports hundreds, mostly young people.
threshold_50_evidence: The cited report states hundreds at this one march, supporting at least 50 without aggregating another event.

location.summary: CIVICUS places march outside the Ministry of National Education in Delmas 83.

scope.summary: One march on Aug 21; not combined with Aug 18 teachers’ sit-in.

organizer.summary: No organizer named in the compiled account.

state_target.summary: The demand for justice addressed a killing by Ministry security staff.

demands.summary: CIVICUS says marchers demanded justice for Zamy Wanderson.

participants_original.summary: CIVICUS reports hundreds, mostly young people.

start_date.summary: CIVICUS dates the march to Aug 21, 2025.

end_date.summary: A one-day march is reported; no later continuation is described.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The report says hundreds took part in this named march.

protester_violence.summary: CIVICUS characterizes the march as peaceful.

state_response.summary: CIVICUS says the Ministry announced disciplinary measures after the march; it does not establish a formal meeting or accommodation.

open_questions: Can the crowd estimate and original Gazette Haiti/X account be independently corroborated?
Did the Ministry’s announced disciplinary action directly respond to demands made at the march or to the prior shooting incident?
Were there any arrests or other state actions during the march?
notes: CIVICUS is a secondary report citing local/social media; the body was read under the September unit and is linked by explicit cross-unit consultation. Do not merge this with the Aug 18 teachers’ sit-in.

title: Displaced residents’ march demanding return to homes with police protection
location: Port-au-Prince streets; residents from Carrefour-Feuille and other lower-capital neighborhoods
scope: One reported demonstration by internally displaced residents seeking safe return to their homes.
organizer: Organizer not named; participants were displaced residents.

state_target.target: Haitian authorities and police protection responsibilities for safe return.
state_target.evidence: Protesters demanded authorities enable them to return home and said they would not return without effective PNH presence; they blamed State responsibility for conditions in their neighborhoods.

demands_original: Safe return home with effective PNH protection; residents rejected cohabitation with armed groups in their neighborhoods.
participants_original: Lawouze reports hundreds of displaced residents.
threshold_50_evidence: The body reports hundreds at this single march.

location.summary: Lawouze places the gathering in Port-au-Prince and identifies participants from Carrefour-Feuille and other lower-capital neighborhoods.

scope.summary: One march on Aug 31; the source does not aggregate any other date or group.

organizer.summary: No named formal organizer; participants are identified as displaced residents.

state_target.summary: Residents called on authorities to enable return and demanded police presence, explicitly assigning State responsibility.

demands.summary: They demanded return home with effective PNH presence and security guarantees.

participants_original.summary: Lawouze says hundreds of displaced residents demonstrated.

start_date.summary: Body dateline dates the demonstration to Aug 31, 2025.

end_date.summary: A Sunday demonstration is described as a one-day action.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Lawouze reports hundreds at the march.

protester_violence.summary: No protester violence is described in the event passage.

state_response.summary: Lawouze reports the DDO-1 attempted to block the march; protesters continued it. This supports a dispersal/obstruction attempt, but not arrests or force.

open_questions: Did the attempted DDO-1 block involve physical dispersal or arrests, or only an effort to block the route?
Did authorities later provide safe-return measures, and did the protest continue after Aug 31?
notes: Code crowd dispersal as yes for the reported State attempt to block the march; no evidence of arrests/beatings/shootings. Exact attendance is not reported.
